name: AiAi
source:
A story about robots and humans falling in love, simple as that.

Ai is short for artificial intelligence in English, and in Chinese it is the pinyin for "love".

[From [url=https://d5300.itch.io/aiai]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个机器人与人类相爱的故事，仅此而已。

AI是英语“人工智能”的缩写，而在中文里，ai也是“爱”的拼音。

[摘自[url=https://d5300.itch.io/aiai]Itch.io[/url]]
